answer_text: Poles are vertices where the edge count is not four; concentrate them in flat, hidden areas so they do not distort shading or subdivision.

claims.text: A pole is any vertex where the number of connected edges is not 4.

claims.text: Poles should be placed in flat or hidden regions to avoid shading artifacts.

sources.excerpt: Place poles in flat areas where shading and subdivision artifacts are least visible.
